text:
Mina: Quick postmortem follow-up for Cerulean on-prem outage — two main issues: VPC peering flaps under replicate-heavy load and a routing cleanup race causing transient tenant isolation. Need clear owners and dates.
Ravi: I'll own peering hardening. I'll tune BGP timers, add soft-restart, and add a test that injects transient packet loss. ETA 14 days. Ticket: https://tracker.redwoodai/INF-2510
Sarah: I'll take connector resilience (restart/backoff + crash recovery tests). Will add fault-injection e2e. ETA 8 business days. Ticket: https://tracker.redwoodai/INF-2511
Diego: I'll triage the routing cleanup race (tenant routing table). Expect root cause + small fix in ~4 days. Ticket: https://tracker.redwoodai/INF-2512
Mina: Action list condensed:
- Ravi (INF-2510): BGP hold-time & soft-restart, customer guidance
- Sarah (INF-2511): connector restart policies, backoff params, e2e fault injection
- Diego (INF-2512): add CAS on cleanup path, race regression test
- Luke/Ops: add canary job and Grafana panel to detect asymmetric peering
Luke: I'll add the canary under infra/runbooks and create an alert. ETA 2 business days.
Diego: Repro logs from stress run:
```
E 2025-02-18T14:23:11Z tenant-router: cleanup failed: key not found
W 2025-02-18T14:23:11Z requeueing cleanup task
E 2025-02-18T14:23:11Z detected concurrent cleanup for tenant=cerulean-42
```
Diego: Plan: introduce compare-and-swap on the cleanup path and add an integration test where two cleanup tasks race.
Sarah: Connector plan: add exponential backoff config, restart policy, and a smoke test that kills the agent container and validates auto-rejoin within threshold.
Ravi: Peering plan: tune bgp hold-time, implement soft-restart, and document recommended customer-side timers. Will add test injecting 100ms packet loss for 30s.
Mina: Org items: 1) Add tickets to Dedicated/Postmortem board, 2) start monthly "isolation rotation" for eng-sre triage ownership.
Sarah: I'll draft the rotation roster and post by EOD Friday.
Ops-bot: Reminder set for #incidents: weekly 09:00 UTC — "Isolation trends triage".
Laura: I'll add a replicate-heavy synthetic scenario to the dedicated perf harness to mirror the traffic pattern that triggered the outage. ETA 12 days.
Mina: Please post ticket links, PRs, and changelog entries here as they land. We will send a private addendum to Cerulean with verification window once INF-2512 deploys. Thanks everyone :tada:
